items.title: Painite
items.line: Painite: Once considered the rarest mineral on Earth with only two known crystals in existence for decades.

items.title: Kyawthuite
items.line: Kyawthuite: Only a single natural specimen of this deep reddish-orange gemstone has ever been found in Burma.

items.title: Taaffeite
items.line: Taaffeite: Over a million times rarer than diamonds, discovered by a gemologist who noticed unusual refraction.

items.title: Jeremejevite
items.line: Jeremejevite: A magnificent sky-blue boron mineral crystal found exclusively in deep granitic pegmatites.

items.title: Poudretteite
items.line: Poudretteite: An ultra-rare pink hexagonal crystal first documented at Mont Saint-Hilaire, Quebec.
